notes.title: AccidentHouse Early Access Ver1.05 has been delivered!
notes.content:
[b]The following bugs have been fixed in this update[/b]
・Fixed a bug that version check failed in some countries
[b]The following elements have been added in this update[/b]
・Added a function that allows you to use Chapter Select once you clear the main story
・Added a function to check the current save data status on the title screen
[b]The following experimental elements have been added in this update[/b]
・Changed the brightness of the light
・Difficulty has become difficult

notes.title: AccidentHouse Early Access Version Ver1.04 has been released!
notes.content:
[b]The following bugs have been fixed in this update[/b]
・Fixed a bug where the distance to the enemy was displayed incorrectly
[b]The following elements have been added in this update[/b]
・Add event
・Added a new enemy "French fries Drone"
[b]The following experimental elements have been added in this update[/b]
・Add link to QuietMansion2
・Changed some enemies to lock on the player from the beginning

notes.title: AccidentHouse Early Access Ver1.03 has been delivered!
notes.content:
[b]The following bugs have been fixed in this update[/b]
・Fixed a bug that can no Enemy pass a of the door
[b]The following elements have been added in this update[/b]
・Increased support can support to developers
・The name list of the crowdfunding supporters can now be accessed from the title screen
・You can possible switch  high quality rendering system
・You can possible switch the environmental sound
・You can enable or switch the jumpscare
[b]It has been added the following experimental elements in this update[/b]
・Widened the difference in difficulty
・Some enemies now make instant death attacks

notes.title: AccidentHouse Early Access Ver1.02 has been delivered!
notes.content:
[b]The following bugs have been fixed in this update[/b]
・Fixed a bug that was chased even if the light was turned off in rare cases
・Fixed a bug where something that should not be seen was visible
[b]The following elements have been added in this update[/b]
・Added an element that makes the movement speed extremely slow for some enemies when the light is turned off
[b]This update includes the following experimental elements[/b]
・I wanted to play with effects, so I added effects
・Fixed the overall difficulty level to be affected by player skills
・Adjust the volume of some loud sounds
・Significantly reduce surprise factors
・Fixed so that enemies do not disappear suddenly
